name: Squaregraphs Have Outerplanar-by-Path Semistrong Hosts
statement: Every finite squaregraph $G$ is isomorphic to a subgraph of $H\boxtimes_s P$ for some outerplanar graph $H$ and path $P$. The outerplanar factor cannot uniformly be replaced by a forest, even in a strong-product host with any fixed complete-graph factor.
comments: The containment is an ordinary subgraph representation and carries no induced or isometric guarantee.
